stuff.title: My Stuff
stuff.role: What you and your agents kept
stuff.compare.title: Compare
stuff.compare.plan.estimateTip: An estimate. When runs overlap on one account, wisp can only trace what they took together, so this splits the total by each run's cost.
stuff.compare.plan.noCost: Not every run reported a cost, so wisp can't split the total between them.
stuff.compare.aboutSame: {name} used about the same tokens and time as A.
stuff.compare.unfinished: {who} didn't finish, so there's no comparison.
stuff.compare.followUps: {name} had a different number of follow-ups, so it isn't the same work.
stuff.compare.harnesses: Different harnesses count differently, so there's no ratio.
stuff.compare.noise: One run each: the same setup varies run to run.
stuff.compare.row.stepsTip: Tools the agent used: commands, reads, edits, searches
stuff.page.published: Published at {at}: anyone with the link can open it
stuff.page.updated: Updated at {at}: anyone with the link can open it
stuff.page.empty.title: Keep what your agents make
stuff.page.empty.description: Keep a picture, video, doc or code from a reply here, or ask an agent: “save that to my stuff”. Agents can build you apps too, that launch from here. Type @ in any prompt to hand an agent something you kept.
stuff.act.revoke: Take back what it may use
stuff.page.addTitle: Add files from this computer (or drop them here)
stuff.page.empty.keep1: Hover a picture, video, doc or code in a reply and press
stuff.page.empty.keep2: to keep it here, or ask an agent:
stuff.page.empty.ask2: . Agents can build you apps too,
stuff.page.empty.mention2: in any prompt to hand an agent something you kept.
stuff.page.empty.or: Drop files here, paste a screenshot, or
stuff.make.title: Make a pane
stuff.make.headTitle: An app that lives in wisp: an agent builds it, or start from one wisp ships with
stuff.make.hint: Say what it should show or do. An agent writes it into My Stuff and pins it. It gets nothing from wisp until you press Allow… on its bar.
stuff.make.label: What should the pane do?
stuff.make.placeholder: A pane that lists my open PRs by repo…
stuff.make.starters: Or start from one of these
stuff.make.runs: Runs on {harness} in an empty folder of its own: it writes the pane, not your code.
stuff.make.making: Making it: it pins itself, and reloads as the agent changes it
stuff.pane.changedSince: This pane changed since you allowed it: allow it again from its bar.
stuff.pane.cardWaiting: A card is already waiting for you.
stuff.pane.unpinned: This pane isn’t pinned any more, so nothing was sent.
stuff.pane.slowDown: Slow down: a pane can start or change {count} tasks a minute.
stuff.pane.use.tasksRead: See your tasks: title, state, project, branch, PR and the one-line summary of the last answer (not the conversation)
stuff.pane.use.tasksWrite: Ask to start tasks and send follow-ups (you confirm each one), and mark tasks done
stuff.pane.use.crewRead: See your crew: names, roles and what they’re doing
stuff.pane.use.usageRead: See your usage windows: how much of each is gone, when it resets, and what each period cost
stuff.panes.heading: Panes
stuff.pane.runsAt: It runs on the computer with wisp, at {url}.
stuff.pane.allowHead.pin.home: Pin {name} on home? It asks to:
stuff.pane.allowHead.pin.task: Pin {name} beside tasks? It asks to:
stuff.pane.allowFoot: wisp keeps it on its own address, but assume whoever wrote it can see what it reads. You can take back access from its menu in My Stuff.
stuff.pane.allowRisk: Its code uses WebRTC, which can send data straight out of wisp.
stuff.pane.notWhile: Not while {name} runs in Full auto.
stuff.pane.card.from: A pane wrote this, not you. Nothing happens until you press Send.
stuff.pane.dialogOpen: wisp has a dialog open: close it, then try again.
stuff.share.title: Share task
stuff.share.who.linkHint: Reads it in a browser. People on your grid import it into their wisp.
stuff.share.who.passHint: Opening or importing it asks for the passkey you give them.
stuff.share.passkeyKept: Kept: type a new one to change it
stuff.share.work.none: no git repo or files to send
stuff.share.work.gitNoRemote: {branch} and uncommitted changes (no remote: the whole history goes)
stuff.share.signIn: Sign in to a wisp Grid first (Settings → Cloud): tasks are shared with the people on it.
stuff.share.where: On {host}. Secrets in the conversation are replaced with [redacted]; connectors go without their keys.
stuff.share.copiedPass: Link copied. Send the passkey separately.
stuff.share.made: Here's the link: copy it to send it.
